current_grouping: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text:
Each operating limitation specified in Secs. 29.1503 through 29.1525, and other information necessary for safe operation, must be--
(a) Included in the Rotorcraft Flight Manual;
(b) Expressed in markings and placards; and
(c) Made available by any other means that will convey the information to the crewmembers.

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text:
[(a) Each operating limitation specified in Secs. 29.1503 through 29.1525 and other limitations and information necessary for safe operation must be established.
(b) The operating limitations and other information necessary for safe operation must be made available to the crewmembers as prescribed in Secs. 29.1541 through 29.1589.]
